purpose: CodeQL CLI bundle with the codeql/<lang>-queries packs, run offline by 02-codeql-sast: one container per language with --build-mode none (audit-codeql) and, when an accepted 02-native-build is wired in, one traced C/C++ replay per native unit (audit-codeql-native).
notes: Not a tool-* image: images/tool_pins.py does not manage it. Authenticity: the bundle sha256 here must equal image.json prebuild and the Dockerfile sha256sum line (codeql_sast.tool_metadata checks all three); the lane script is COPYed from scripts/ and hashed into the job's inputs. The traced lane runs the same lane script in audit-codeql-native (Dockerfile.native pins the same bundle sha256); its replay script is COPYed from scripts/ as well and hashed into the plan, and the repo query pack queries/appsec-graph-cpp is mounted read-only at run time (never copied into the image).
